question_en: Write a useLocalStorage hook in React.
answer_html_vi:
useLocalStorage persists state vào localStorage, tự đồng bộ khi value thay đổi.

js
function useLocalStorage(key, initial) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const item = localStorage.getItem(key);
      return item ? JSON.parse(item) : initial;
    } catch { return initial; }
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
  }, [key, value]);
  return [value, setValue];
}

Test khả năng viết custom hooks với side effects.
answer_html_en:
useLocalStorage persists state to localStorage and re-syncs whenever the value changes.

js
function useLocalStorage(key, initial) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const item = localStorage.getItem(key);
      return item ? JSON.parse(item) : initial;
    } catch { return initial; }
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
  }, [key, value]);
  return [value, setValue];
}

Tests your ability to write custom hooks that carry side effects.
